concepts.proposed_markdown: A merchant POS can override Customer Area terminal tipping suggestions for one Terminal API payment by sending `AskGratuity` with a version-appropriate Base64 `Operation` object. The shopper chooses among the presented tip/no-tip options; `RequestedAmount` is the purchase base, while the payment response's `AuthorizedAmount` includes any selected tip. The website guide requires terminal software 1.97+ and changes the `Operation` shape at 1.101; exact formats stay in its source/raw snapshot.
warnings: The raw request/response examples have different ServiceID values, so do not treat them as a verified matched transaction.
